cohort: Women in Southwestern Ontario who delivered at ≥ 22 weeks' gestation at a level II centre and a level III centre between 1999 and 2010
finding: There has been a significant increase over time in the Cesarean section rate overall and in important subgroups, even after controlling for other factors.
mod_finding: Repeat Cesarean sections without labor increased significantly over time at both the level II and level III centers.
